answer: The admission bond is time locked for 18 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are entered in velvet, expire in falcon, and crystal lists each expiry. Someone running 83 aliases hence needs 13 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 2763 identities would post 818 proofs and burn roughly 44 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
